en.headline: Coach charged over alleged slap and outdoor punishment of boy at Cheung Chau camp
en.dek: A 51-year-old woman faces two counts of assault and ill-treatment of a child under her care stemming from a 2024 training camp incident; she was granted bail.
body: A 51-year-old coach appeared at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday charged with assaulting and ill-treating an eight-year-old boy under her care.

According to the charges, Zhao Yiqun allegedly slapped the child and required him to stand outdoors on a basketball court in hot weather as punishment at Caritas Ming Hui Camp on Cheung Chau on 8 August 2024. The boy later told his mother, prompting the report.

The defendant did not enter a plea. Principal Magistrate Cheung Chi-wai adjourned the case to 23 September to allow discussions between the prosecution and defence. Zhao was granted bail of HK$2,000 on condition that she not contact prosecution witnesses.

zh.headline: 女教練涉長洲營地掌摑及罰企8歲男童被控兩虐兒罪
zh.dek: 51歲教練趙軼群被控於2024年在長洲明愛明暉營襲擊及虐待所看管男童，今在東區裁判法院提堂，獲准保釋至9月再訊。
body: 一名51歲女教練星期三在東區裁判法院被控兩項對所看管兒童或少年人的罪行，包括襲擊及虐待或忽略。
控罪指，趙軼群於2024年8月8日在長洲明愛明暉營，作為對8歲男童負有看管責任的人，故意掌摑該男童，並要求他在熱天下到戶外籃球場罰企，其方式相當可能導致男童受到不必要苦楚或健康損害。男童其後告知母親，事件因而揭發。
被告暫毋須答辯。主任裁判官張志偉將案件押後至9月23日，以便控辯雙方商討。被告獲准以2,000元保釋，期間不得接觸控方證人。
